concept.hr: Vlasnik, grupa, ostali: odlučuje prva klasa koja odgovara; maska ACL-a
concept.en: Owner, group, other: the first class that matches decides; the ACL mask

summary.hr: Odaberi proces i datoteku pa prati provjeru: klase stalnim redom, prva koja odgovara odlučuje, a maska ograničava srednje unose.
summary.en: Pick a process and a file and step the check: classes in a fixed order, the first that matches decides, the mask limits the middle entries.

title.hr: Vlasnik bez prava, a svi ostali smiju
title.en: An owner with no rights, and everyone else may

concept.hr: Prva klasa koja odgovara je konačna: prava se ne zbrajaju
concept.en: The first class that matches is final: rights do not add up

title.hr: Unos kaže rwx, maska kaže rw-
title.en: The entry says rwx, the mask says rw-

concept.hr: Između upisanog i onoga što vrijedi stoji maska
concept.en: The mask stands between what is written and what applies
